text:
infra-alerts: PAGING: runtime p99 latency spike on /v1/generate (3x baseline) and elevated 5xx rate. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/incidents/2134567890 :rotating_light:
ryan: Ack, I'm on it — checking canary and recent rollout metadata.
maria: saw this pop ~2m after release/v2.4.7 hit canary slice A.
sachin: looking at runtime logs — batcher queue growing, lots of tiny batches. kernel selector is falling back to compat kernel repeatedly. snippet:
```
[2026-02-12T15:12:01Z] runtime.kernel: fallback -> compat-kernel (reason=unsupported_vec_op)
batcher.queue_size=312 avg_batch_size=1.4 inflight=48
errors: model_inference_latency=1200ms p99
```
ryan: can we flip the runtime kill-switch for the new kernel selector? need to force older kernel until we root cause.
sachin: I can flip it, what's the flag name?
ryan: flag = runtime_kernel_selector_v2, set -> false. quick command:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' -d '{"flag":"runtime_kernel_selector_v2","value":false}'
```
devops-bot: sachin invoked toggle API: runtime_kernel_selector_v2=false (request id=ff-9a7b).
sachin: flipped it. monitoring now.
ryan: seeing p99 drop starting ~30s after flip, batcher queue size trending down. good so far.
deploy-bot: notify: rollback option available for release/v2.4.7 — react with :thumbsup: to start full rollback to commit abc123.
maria: can we avoid full rollback? canary shows partial recovery on flag flip. recommend keep canary paused and not promote until postmortem.
ryan: agree — hold rollout, do not promote. we should notify CS. @cs-notify please ping affected customers.
cs-notify: notified top-tier customers (acct IDs: C123, C987). will escalate if they report issues. draft comms ready.
sachin: logs show kernel fallback was triggered by a vector op pattern introduced in kernel_v2's codepath; fallback path causes micro-batching (many size=1 batches) and head-of-line latency.
sylvia: taking primary on-call handoff in 18m. ryan, please add a short handoff note to the incident board and confirm runbook step executed (kill-switch flipped, canary paused).
ryan: handoff note added to incident board: "kill-switch flipped -> runtime_kernel_selector_v2=false, canary promotion paused, rollback not initiated." traces: https://logs.redwood/trace/2134567890
maria: throughput normalized ~2m after flip, p99 back to baseline, error rate dropping. checkpointing observation logs.
ryan: action items: (1) postmortem ticket -> assign ryan/maria/sachin; (2) write unit/regression test for kernel selector vector ops; (3) evaluate safer rollout gating for kernel changes.
sylvia: acknowledged. I'll pick up monitoring and liaise with CS for any followups during my shift.
deploy-bot: rollback endpoint standing by. no rollback executed.
devops-bot: incident log updated: mitigation=flag-toggle, duration=~12m of visible customer impact, scope=canary slice A only.
ryan: closing active pager — we're in mitigation and holding rollout. will open formal incident page for detailed RCA. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
